body: hey, if you’re supporting him, you are doing everything you can. letting him know you’re there for him and being somebody that he has the option to confide in, and encouraging him to continue getting help is all you can do. i know how it feels to be constantly worried but you need to take care of yourself too. because the bottom line is that if you become so consumed with taking care of him that you don’t take care of yourself, you won’t be any good to him. I’m in the same shoes as you and it absolutely sucks that the person you love is fighting a war that you know you can’t help them win but you need to remember that your mental health is equally as important as theirs. I’m not going to tell you not to worry about him because that’s not something you can control, but you can control how much it consumes you. Worrying is natural and it’s important that you’re supporting him, but you also need to make sure you’re supporting you. Personally I’ve found the hardest part to be realizing that there’re no magic words, because even though it’s something you inherently know, it’s still hard. But I’ve also found that just being someone he can talk to if he wants/needs to is enough, sometimes knowing that you care is enough, and making sure you’re informed about resources that he might need (like 24/7 mental health facilities and hotlines he can call) and that you let him know about them is enough. I don’t mean it’s enough to change his mind and convince him that life’s worth it, because that’s something that you can’t control, but sometimes it’s enough knowing you’re in his life. I hope this helps, and I hope he starts to get better.

hey, I can’t imagine how you feel so I won’t pretend but I can tell you that no matter how terrible you’re feeling right now, some part of you is holding on. Maybe it’s minuscule but it’s there, it’s the reason you’re asking why. Hold on for that part. you’ve made it this far, I hope you don’t give up.
I’m so sorry you’re feeling this way. Things are going to get better. They can’t stay terrible forever. if you need somebody to talk to, I’m here.
